finite_concept_catalog.reason: It measures how broadly the 240 continuous-auction closes remain above versus below the fixed 09:31 opening reference. The complete 139-definition library contains endpoint return, signed path efficiency, late return, close-range occupancy entropy, cumulative-VWAP crossing, path-shape and exact-level mechanisms, but no fixed-opening-reference directional occupation time.
It would restate tail concentration already represented by return-variance entropy, bipower jump-variation share and volatility-resolution mechanisms.
Exact open/high/low/close equality would be a sparse binary reexpression of the terminal wick-balance, close-location, bar-direction and body-to-range geometry families.
It recombines return-sign continuity, reversal-energy, weak-order entropy and price-update topology without a new source or economic channel.
It would substitute body magnitude into the already terminal amount/range clock-center family and would also attempt a prohibited Campaign109 body-magnitude family continuation.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_open_reference_directional_occupancy_240m
selected_candidate.formula: mean(sign(log(close_i / open_09_31))) over exactly 240 closes from 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00, with exact equality contributing zero
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A stock that spends most of the continuous session above its opening reference exhibits broad intraday demand persistence rather than a terminal-only spike, which may carry into the next-open to third-close horizon.
selected_candidate.fixed_reference: the raw open of the selected 09:31 bar
selected_candidate.tie_semantics: an exact close equal to the fixed opening reference contributes zero and remains in the 240-bar denominator
